title: Vertex AI Claude passthrough must filter client anthropic-beta per endpoint config
answers: Vertex AI rejects my request with 400 Unexpected value for the anthropic-beta header
Claude Code requests fail through a Vertex AI gateway endpoint after a new beta header
How do I control which anthropic-beta values are forwarded to Claude on Vertex?
vertex_anthropic_betas gateway option for beta header
body:
Symptom: Requests through a Vertex AI gateway endpoint for Claude fail with a 400 'Unexpected value(s) ... for the anthropic-beta header' after the client starts sending a newer beta (for example advisor-tool-2026-03-01), while the same request works against the Anthropic API.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers forwarded the client's anthropic-beta unchanged through the shared Anthropic header merge; Vertex validates the header against its own supported set and rejects the whole request, where the Anthropic API ignores unknown values.
Fix pattern: Filter the header in the Vertex Claude subclass before calling super()._get_headers, driven by VertexAIConfig.vertex_anthropic_betas (mlflow/gateway/config.py:VertexAIConfig) via mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_filter_anthropic_betas. Leave the shared Anthropic merge untouched.
Constraints: None forwards the header unchanged, [] drops it, a non-empty list keeps only listed values and drops the header if none remain. Matching on the header name is case-insensitive. Gemini and MaaS providers on Vertex are not affected by this option.
applies: Vertex AI endpoints serving Claude models on the passthrough/raw proxy routes; any other provider that must strip client headers before forwarding upstream.
says: Claude requests through the AI gateway fail with an unexpected beta header error.
Coding assistant tools targeting Claude work directly but get rejected through Vertex gateway endpoints.
Allow gateway administrators to configure which beta features are forwarded to Claude on Vertex.
Filter out unsupported client beta flags so Vertex AI does not reject Claude requests.
Upgraded client libraries break when calling Claude models through the gateway due to unrecognized betas.
search: Vertex AI endpoints serving Claude models on passthrough and raw proxy routes must filter client anthropic-beta headers using _filter_anthropic_betas in _VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers before delegating upstream. Header filtering is configured by vertex_anthropic_betas on VertexAIConfig in mlflow/gateway/config.py, where None forwards headers unchanged, an empty list drops them, and a non-empty list retains only matching values. Matching on the header name is case-insensitive, while Gemini and MaaS providers on Vertex remain unaffected.
